capabilities: scan Markdown notes, tasks, journals, and projects in the existing vault
complete tasks and update project status by writing back to the original files
open or create daily notes from a calendar widget
reorder, add, hide, and restore dashboard widgets
run configurable countdown and count-up focus timers
disambiguation: Not a theme or a static homepage publisher; it is an in-app widget dashboard rendered inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop-only at initial release; requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in startup overview screen that gathers tasks, daily notes, projects, and recent files in one place without extra plugins like Dataview.
summary: Theme-aware homepage dashboard that scans an existing vault and shows reorderable widgets for tasks, journals, projects, and recent notes.
